dedupe_keys.name: fact sim browser discrete event simulator

description: fact_sim is a browser-based discrete-event simulator published by the suzuking001 maintainer. A node editor represents sources, equipment, queues, routing, carriers, pallets and stations. Bundled manufacturing examples show production lines and internal transport, while the engine also supports general resource-constrained flows. Users configure event timing and resource rules, then inspect timing charts and export CSV results. Scenarios can be saved as JSON or shared through URL state. Coverage is a user-defined process network with second-level timing visibility, not a measured factory dataset or fixed geographic area. Public source and a hosted demonstration are free under Apache-2.0, and a local static web server is sufficient for the documented basic launch. A limitation is that model assumptions, processing times and downtime distributions require independent calibration. Different documented engine modes can also produce different execution behaviour, and this review did not reproduce the repository's engine comparisons. The tool supports capacity and bottleneck studies and is comparable in purpose to discrete-event service models such as model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des. Browser visualisations are outputs of the specified model, not evidence of actual facility performance.
